critical_findings.finding: A runtime-only minimality pass can wrongly delete autonomous discovery as dead-end transit.
A lawful direct-V554 basis for one use does not authorize later cross-time semantics without a V553-governed basis for the later use.
Thin V3 boundaries must not replace exact requested J-way PSEPF geometry with modal/top-k/marginal/scalar summaries.
Per-source supported/conflicting/noncomparable states cannot be collapsed into one global availability/negative state.
Transitive provenance reachability grants no cross-universe pooling/joint-use authority.
Denied/noncomparable/negative-authority objects must survive standalone closure; missing positive object is not a positive absence claim.
Broad topology preserves the V3 causal boundary, but terminal divergent-life behavior cannot be certified until V3_EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_METABOLISM_AUTHORITY exists.
Opaque upstream audit refs can recreate empirical/structural -> persona leakage if V2 may dereference them for expression.
Unique governance/admission/lifecycle/negative-authority/terminal-service meaning counts as unique work even without a new producer-domain ontology.
